queries: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT i.invoice_number, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(ili.derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(CAST(l.derived_total_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT i.invoice_number, SUM(CAST(l.derived_total_cost AS REAL)) / NULLIF(SUM(l.derived_product_cost), 0) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

responses.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average ratio is the mean of per-line-item ratios (derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost), not total cost sum divided by product cost sum. Line items with zero derived_product_cost would cause division issues (NULL in SQLite, error in some other databases).
Ties in line item count at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily, since the request gives no tie-breaker.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of aggregates: sum of derived_total_cost divided by sum of derived_product_cost per invoice, rather than the average of per-line ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(ili.derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average ratio is the mean of the per-line-item ratios (derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost), not total of costs divided by total of costs. Lines with a zero product cost yield NULL ratios and are skipped in the average but still counted as line items.
Ties in line item count are broken by ascending invoice number, since the request does not specify a tie-break.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of sums: the average ratio computed as SUM(derived_total_cost) / SUM(derived_product_cost) across each invoice's line items.

assumptions.assumption: The average is the mean of per-line ratios (derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost), not the ratio of sums. Lines with a zero derived_product_cost would cause division errors or NULLs, and none are assumed.
Ties in line item count are broken by invoice_number ascending, since the request does not specify tie-breaking.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of summed costs per invoice (SUM(total)/SUM(product cost)) instead of the mean of per-line ratios.
